title: I Let the Fast-Food Headset Catch the Insult They Thought Was Off-Mic

parts.text: I asked for no onions at the board. The headset voice said copy. At the window a worker muttered, some people need a life, still on the speaker I could hear from my car. I was thirty. I smiled, took the bag, found onions, and asked for the manager. I repeated the sentence. The manager listened to the loop because drive-thrus keep loops. They remade the burger and spoke to the headset. I ate in a parking space that smelled like fries and accountability. I did not post a face. I posted a habit: if the speaker is live, the insult is a policy issue. Onions are optional. Commentary is not a condiment.
